info.description: Menu dishes. Lives in cms_dishes; data was migrated once from the legacy public.dishes table, which is kept untouched as a backup.

dish_id.description: Identificador interno. Se asigna solo al crear el plato; no hace falta rellenarlo.

display_name.description: Nombre en español, solo para poder verlo y buscarlo en el listado. Se rellena automáticamente desde el campo `name`; no hace falta editarlo.

photo.description: Upload the dish photo here. Its public URL is copied into the `image` field automatically, which is what the website reads.

image.description: Public image URL used by the website. Filled in automatically from `photo` - you normally don't edit this by hand.

featured.description: Show this dish in the 'popular dishes' section on the home page. If no dish is featured, that whole section is hidden.
